It also says `node src/app.js` "will now print `listening on 8080` and exit 0 instead of `bad config: ...` and exit 1". That covers the fix hiding the broken file and the app starting on defaults. Builder steps 2 and 6 make the same point.
2. Builder step 3 tells the builder to replace the 'bad JSON throws' test in test/config.test.js with one where loadConfig "returns a value deepEqual to {} and does not throw". Step 5 requires npm test to pass.
3. Verifier Check 1 runs loadConfig on `{port: 9000`, which is invalid JSON. It PASSes only when nothing is thrown and the output is `{} true 0`, meaning an empty plain object.
